entities.name: First Qur'anic Revelation
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The event in 610 CE when, according to Islamic tradition, the angel Jibril (Gabriel) appeared to Muhammad in the cave of Hira on Mount Nur near Mecca and commanded him to "Read!" (Iqra'!) — revelating the first verses of Surah al-'Alaq (96:1-5). This event, occurring during the month of Ramadan on Laylat al-Qadr (the Night of Power), marks the beginning of Qur'anic revelation and the prophetic mission of Muhammad. It is one of the pivotal moments in human history, initiating a religious tradition that would come to encompass nearly a quarter of the global population.
